macros.name: STcopy
macros.doc: To avoid having to re-enter identical formulas in adjacent cells, spreadtab provides the \STcopy instruction.

macros.name: STprintnum
macros.doc: Each number processed by spreadtab is given to the \STprintnum macro in the final array.

macros.name: STrep
macros.doc: Used in the argument of \STxp, it allows you to generate empty cells or identical lines in a concise way.

macros.name: STreset
macros.doc: To return to the default values, you can run the \STreset macro at any time.

macros.name: STset
macros.doc: The \STset macro includes in its mandatory argument a csv of keys = 〈values〉 to specify settings that operate for the rest of the document.

macros.name: STxp
macros.doc: If the macro \STxp is present one or more times, its argument is expanded to the maximum.
